§3§lTen-pulls and delivery§r
Default animations last §12.8 seconds§r for a single draw and §11.4 seconds§r for a ten-pull. The server waits another §1150 milliseconds§r after the animation before delivering rewards.

Members of the same team share pity counters within each pool. Any member's draws advance that pool's counter. A ten-pull still requires payment for its draws.

§3§lCompletion§r
Read the ten-pull cost and shared-pity rules, then tick the checkbox. This quest does not require holding funds or performing a ten-pull.
